30:33.text: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

30:34.text: So that they will deny what We have granted them.
Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

30:35.text: Or have We sent down to them an authority
, and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?

30:36.text: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.

30:37.text: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts
? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

30:38.text: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face
of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.

30:39.text: And whatever you give for interest
to increase within the wealth of people
will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh,
of Allāh - those are the multipliers.

30:40.text: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

30:41.text: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by
what the hands of people have earned so He
may let them taste part of
what they have done that perhaps they will return
